column1: # Frozen source-registration inventory for cloud FMan telemetry.
# Regenerate this file from the exact Fedimint input when the pin or bundled
# module set changes. `flake.nix` scans every Rust source in the entire pinned
# Fedimint input and the exact Cargo-selected stability-pool server input for
# producer identity, and compares them with these rows. The separate Markdown
# privacy inventory explains labels and review rationale; this compact file owns
# `package` rows are the normal and target-specific dependency closure rooted at
# stability-pool-server. Build and dev dependencies are intentionally excluded:
# they do not link into the FMan runtime image. Any unaccounted same-source
# Cargo.lock edge fails the check rather than silently evading this boundary.
